name: Google Calendar
hint: A web OAuth client in your Google Cloud project with the Google Calendar API enabled, and one account’s refresh token for these scopes under https://www.googleapis.com/auth/: calendar.events, calendar.calendarlist.readonly, calendar.calendars.readonly, calendar.events.freebusy, for example from the OAuth 2.0 Playground; an External app left in Testing gets tokens that end after 7 days.

pick.name: list_events
pick.says: Lists the events on a calendar; timeMin and timeMax are RFC 3339 with an offset (2026-12-01T09:00:00-05:00), and a nextPageToken in the answer is the pageToken of the next page. orderBy is startTime or updated, and startTime needs singleEvents=true, which lists each occurrence of a recurring event as an event of its own. Each event comes in full unless fields names less, e.g. nextPageToken,items(id,summary,start,end,location).

pick.name: get_event
pick.says: Returns one event by the id that list_events or list_event_instances gives.

pick.name: list_calendars
pick.says: Lists the calendars on this account’s calendar list, each with its id, summary (title), timeZone and accessRole; its own main calendar has primary set to true. minAccessRole=writer keeps those whose events it can change.

pick.name: get_calendar
pick.says: Returns a calendar’s summary (title), description and timeZone, an IANA name such as Europe/Zurich.

pick.name: list_event_instances
pick.says: Lists the occurrences of a recurring event, each with its own id and originalStartTime; update_event takes that id to change one occurrence alone. timeMin and timeMax are RFC 3339 with an offset.

pick.name: get_free_busy
pick.says: Returns when the calendars asked about are busy between two times, as start and end ranges without event details, in UTC unless the body sets timeZone. Body: {"timeMin", "timeMax", "items": [{"id"}]}, times as RFC 3339 with an offset; an id is a calendar’s, and a person’s email is usually their main calendar’s.

pick.name: create_event
pick.says: Creates an event; only start and end are required, and sendUpdates=all emails the guests. Body: {"summary", "description", "location", "start": {"dateTime": RFC 3339 with an offset} or {"date": "yyyy-mm-dd"} for a whole day, "end" alike, "attendees": [{"email"}], "recurrence": ["RRULE:…"] with a "timeZone" in start and end}; conferenceDataVersion=1 with "conferenceData": {"createRequest": {"requestId": a new string, "conferenceSolutionKey": {"type": "hangoutsMeet"}}} adds a Google Meet.

pick.name: create_event_from_text
pick.says: Creates an event from a simple text string describing it, given as text. Body: {}.

pick.name: update_event
pick.says: Changes only the fields the body names, such as {"summary"} or {"start", "end"} shaped as in create_event; an array such as attendees replaces the whole list, so send every guest to add one. sendUpdates=all emails the guests; conferenceDataVersion=1 lets it add or change conferenceData.
